rows.en:
Impulse 7
This machine was developed to break free of the Cloud Stream that blankets the skies.
Flying Troopers (FTs) were developed from Ground Troopers (GTs). Impulse 7 is the seventh prototype in that line.

{x00}

This machine is the ninth Flying Trooper (FT) prototype.
Although numbered ninth, it was completed before Impulse 7 and underwent extensive performance testing.

{x00}

Its detailed capabilities are shrouded in mystery.

rows.en:
Gunblaze A
The Gunblaze family has 26 variants built around a common main frame. Gunblaze Assault is the most representative of them.
These outstanding ground combat machines made it possible for the Cloud Alliance forces to win the Third Claudian War on Claudia.

{x00}
rows.notes: Restores the explicitly stated setting on Claudia and the source assertion that Gunblaze made victory possible. The existing instrumental wording weakens the source necessity slightly. Independent accuracy reviewed; editorial/proofread rechecked after application.

rows.en:
Gunblaze B
Gunblaze Backup is configured for medium-range support.
A shoulder-mounted sensor unit allows precise fire from medium range while the machine takes a kneeling stance. It can also evade rapidly to avoid enemy counterattacks after firing. This variant combines Gunblaze mobility with supporting artillery fire.

{x00}
rows.notes: Preserves the kneeling firing stance, sensor, counterattack context and rapid evasion capability.

rows.en:
Gunblaze C
Gunblaze Cold is configured for combat in cold regions.
It was developed with an emphasis on pilot survivability and mobility in freezing conditions. Systems throughout the machine are protected against freezing, and dedicated equipment allows it to operate on glaciers and in blizzards.

{x00}
rows.notes: Survivability refers to the pilot; mobility refers to the machine.

rows.en:
Gunblaze D
Gunblaze Destruction is configured for demolition and annihilation operations.
Designed to break through enemy front-line forces and demolish strong defenses such as fortresses, it boasts unrivaled firepower and payload capacity. Once its ammunition is exhausted, it promptly withdraws from the battlefield.

{x00}
rows.notes: Retains both anti-force and anti-fortification roles, payload capacity and withdrawal after ammunition exhaustion.

rows.en:
Gunblaze E
Gunblaze Express is configured for high-speed resupply.
GT units deploy at very high speed in combat, so their supply units must be just as fast.
Transport takes priority over armament, with container trays fitted to the shoulders, back, waist and legs.

{x00}
rows.notes: The source specifies container trays installed at the four locations, not the containers themselves. Restore the hardware detail without changing the resupply role. Independent accuracy reviewed; editorial/proofread rechecked after application.

rows.en:
Gunblaze G
Gunblaze Ghost is configured for illusion-based combat.
It creates a Vision Field and projects decoy images. This is highly effective tactically, concealing the strength of friendly forces from the enemy and reducing the chance of being hit.
It can project a wide variety of images, provided the data is available.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze H
Gunblaze Hover is configured for hover-mobile combat.
Gunblaze is capable of high-speed ground combat, but some ravines are impassable and wetlands reduce its mobility. This equipment overcomes those obstacles and greatly expands its operating range.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze I
Gunblaze Interceptor is configured for disruption and interception.
The I configuration was developed to focus Gunblaze's mobility on disrupting and intercepting enemies. Its role calls for greater consideration of mobility than the similarly heavily equipped D configuration.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze J
Gunblaze Jamming is configured for information warfare.
Its equipment is designed to block and disrupt the transmission of information. It deploys a jamming dome to form a magnetic-field lens, generating powerful jamming. It can also focus a powerful magnetic field on a precise point, enabling special tactics such as hindering a machine's operation or destroying electrical circuits.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze K
Gunblaze Knight is configured for close combat.
GT combat normally centers on firearms, but close combat accounts for a large share of the fighting. This machine is the culmination of research into that role. No other equipment configuration can surpass Knight in close combat.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze L
Gunblaze Long Range Killer is configured for ultra-long-range combat.
The Cloud Alliance forces had successfully broadened their medium- and long-range attack options by exploiting Gunblaze's mobility. They developed this equipment to enable ultra-long-range, intercontinental ballistic fire.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze M
Gunblaze Marine is configured for underwater combat.
This equipment was developed to extend Gunblaze's operations into underwater and undersea environments. It can carry out a wide range of missions, from ambushing passing ships and submarines to amphibious landings and securing the area ashore. Claws fitted to its arms and legs also allow close combat.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified. Accuracy fix: The source specifies underwater and undersea operation. Out to sea can instead assert offshore/surface reach and drops the explicit undersea environment. Uncertainty: The source overlaps the categories underwater and undersea; do not infer a specific inland-water capability.

rows.en:
Gunblaze N
Gunblaze Night Attack is configured for night assaults.
This equipment fully adapts Gunblaze's mobility for nighttime use. It cannot turn invisible, but heat-dissipation filters and other equipment help it blend into the darkness.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze O
Gunblaze Overhead is configured for aerial combat.
This equipment extends Gunblaze's operations into the sky. The Cloud Stream naturally makes high-altitude flight virtually impossible, but the machine is built to fly and glide.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze P
Gunblaze Personnel is configured for antipersonnel combat.
This equipment was developed to fight personnel. It carries three Cart Gunners with armor comparable to a GT's. Out of respect for human life, the fitted pulse-cannon armament can also serve as a long-range stun gun.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified. Accuracy fix: Its follows the main machine as the subject and can assign the cannon to it. The source says only that the cannon is equipped after mentioning the three Cart Gunners; keep its carrier unspecified. Uncertainty: The source and neighbors do not settle whether the armament is on the main machine or the Cart Gunners, nor whether the named cannon has one or multiple instances.

rows.en:
Gunblaze Q
Gunblaze Quarterback is configured for overall command support.
Normally, pilots of crewed Gunblazes coordinate AIM (unmanned) units. This equipment coordinates information from the entire battlefield during larger battles. All of the machine's capacity is devoted to information processing so that it can handle large amounts of information efficiently.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze R
Gunblaze Reconator is configured for reconnaissance in force.
It normally operates covertly, but its primary mission is reconnaissance in force, using its mobility and wide-area identification capabilities. During these operations, it may also coordinate with AIM (unmanned) units to disrupt the enemy.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified. Expanded name is provisional; phonetic English reconstruction remains uncertain.

rows.en:
Gunblaze S
Gunblaze Sapper is configured for combat engineering.
Its equipment can reshape the terrain into a suitable environment, making terrain effects more favorable to the ground-combat Gunblazes. After completing its work, it can change equipment and return to the front as another Gunblaze configuration. It can also use its equipment in hand-to-hand combat.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze T
Gunblaze Taking Off is configured for assassination operations.
It was successfully developed after research into optics and material composition. Its system, called optical transmission camouflage, makes it disappear by allowing the background behind it to pass through, rather than projecting that background onto its front.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified. Expanded name is provisional; phonetic English reconstruction remains uncertain.

rows.en:
Gunblaze U
Gunblaze Unite is configured for combat with additional armor.
This equipment was developed to keep hits received to a minimum in GT combat, where accurate shooting has become the norm. It maximizes defense while minimizing added weight, so it weighs little more than the A configuration. It is used when hits are unavoidable, such as when assaulting enemy strongholds.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified. Expanded name is provisional; phonetic English reconstruction remains uncertain. Accuracy fix: Effects of incoming fire changes the source claim about minimizing hits received into a claim about mitigating their consequences. Preserve the source even though extra armor makes damage mitigation seem logical. Uncertainty: The same source later describes unavoidable hits when assaulting strongholds. This is a source tension, not evidence authorizing a silent repair.

rows.en:
Gunblaze V
Gunblaze Volt is configured for electrical attacks.
GTs are weapons built from advanced electronic equipment. This configuration was developed to destroy them from within. On contact with enemy units, it uses a stun wire to deliver a momentary high-voltage current and silence them.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

rows.en:
Gunblaze W
Gunblaze Wrestle is configured for hand-to-hand combat.
Close combat is frequent in GT battles. This equipment was developed to pursue bare-handed fighting that feels more natural to the pilot. Additional external armor over its standard armor further increases its rigidity and strength.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified. Expanded name is provisional; phonetic English reconstruction remains uncertain. Accuracy fix: Physical instincts introduces a specific instinct/reflex interpretation. The source uses a broad sense/feel term; preserve that breadth instead of narrowing it to instincts. Uncertainty: The source does not explain the precise sensory/control mechanism. Senses keeps that uncertainty; editorial may improve naturalness while retaining the broad meaning. Editorial rendering of broad sense/feel wording; source rechecked, no mechanism added.

rows.en:
Gunblaze X
Gunblaze Extra is configured for special combat operations.
This equipment was developed to make the environment more favorable to friendly forces. It can smash the extremely hard bedrock of the planet Claudia and dig its way underground.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia equipment profile; no speaker or listener. Full source meaning drafted before fit. Project English name; official spelling unverified.

Meisarge
This machine was developed during the Third Claudian War to achieve a higher level of spatial maneuverability.
Combining different propulsion systems, including hover systems and thrusters, results in poor energy efficiency and a shorter operating time than other GTs. However, it has exceptional mobility beyond normal GT capabilities and formidable combat performance.

{x00}
rows.notes: Equipment encyclopedia; no speaker/listener. Complete source and adjacent entries read. Project names remain provisional; numbering is explicit in source. Independent accuracy complete; parent editorial and proofreading complete. Display fit is separately recorded in versioned rendered_evidence. Accuracy: Restore energy as the explicit kind of inefficiency, not a general inefficiency claim. Higher-level spatial maneuverability is supported in this propulsion/mobility context; no higher-dimensional travel is established.

rows.en:
Thunderbolt
This prototype for highly mobile close combat descends from Meisarge and focuses on mobility and hand-to-hand fighting.
It uses overwhelming mobility to close rapidly with the enemy, then smashes the target with a single blow. Its attacks are so powerful that the destroyed machine is difficult to identify.

{x00}

Thunderchief - Unmanned
This unmanned GT with enhanced internal mechanisms was developed by the Deon Federation forces.
It was designed for hand-to-hand combat, emphasizing frame strength, overwhelming power and speed. It has enough joint strength and power to use its own sturdy frame as a weapon. Development also aimed to improve the various performance characteristics associated with those capabilities.

{x00}
rows.notes: Equipment encyclopedia; no speaker/listener. Complete source and adjacent entries read. Project names remain provisional; numbering is explicit in source. Deege - Unmanned
This unmanned GT, enhanced for combat in specific environments, was developed by the Deon Federation forces.
It specializes in desert combat, in Claudia's harshest environment. GTs normally have ample capability for fighting in environments such as deserts, but this machine has additional heat resistance and equipment to protect against sand and dust.

{x00}

This large unmanned GT for long-range artillery combat was developed by the Deon Federation forces.
Its large frame carries multiple long-range guns, making it a veritable mobile fortress. Its armor has a rounded shape to resist incoming fire at medium and close range.

This unmanned GT for underwater combat was developed by the Deon Federation forces.
Its upper body is nearly hemispherical to account for water resistance, while its lower body differs little from a standard GT's. This unbalanced appearance has led to rumors that it was hastily assembled from two different kinds of GT.

This Flying Trooper (FT) has a transformation mechanism. Its special Cloud Stream Hole (CSH) navigation dramatically increases its top speed and range.
Its two CS Mega Launchers harness the Cloud Stream (CS) and are ultimate weapons of destruction. No other mobile weapon can match their attacks against a single target.

This machine was conceived to give a Flying Trooper (FT) even greater Gunblaze-style mobility and capability in suppression operations.
It was successfully made smaller while retaining its firepower. Its Cloud Stream (CS) Absorber allows descents from high altitude and brief bursts of highly mobile sliding movement.

Wahrheit
This is an H-type Flying Trooper (FT).
It was designed to achieve a structure and movements even more humanlike than those of a Ground Trooper (GT), and succeeded. Along with a solid blade, it carries small but powerful cannons on both shoulders. A single blow from the Spinel Lancer it wields can split the earth.

Rayfall
This is a P-type Flying Trooper (FT).
It was developed with two main goals: mobility within the Cloud Stream and extended deployment.
Its acrobatic movements bewilder enemies and prevent them from fixing their aim on it.

{x00}
rows.notes: Equipment encyclopedia; no speaker/listener. Complete source and adjacent entries read. Project names remain provisional; numbering is explicit in source. rows.en:
Dunbine
Shot Weapon built three prototypes of this Aura Battler (AB), which emphasizes mobility.
Its firearms are mounted externally to reduce dead weight.
As a prototype, it has the drawback that its performance depends on the pilot's aura power, making it sensitive and difficult to handle.

{x00}

rows.en:

This is Todd Guinness's personal unit, one of the three Dunbine prototypes. Its body is painted black.
All three Dunbines have the same basic performance, but compared with Sho, it is hard to say that Todd brought out its full potential.

{x00}

Its Aura Battler form excels in combat. In Wing Caliber form, its carrying capacity and cruising speed increase, allowing it to cover a wide operational area.

Leprechaun
Alongside mobility, this design sought greater firepower through built-in weapons.
However, excessive emphasis on armament increased its weight relative to its power output. The result was a poorly balanced machine that excelled only in firepower.

{x00}

Shot modified the high-performance Zwarth, which could be called the ultimate Aura Battler, to create this most powerful and vicious Aura Battler (AB).

Its only weapon is a sword, for its overwhelming attack power makes firearms unnecessary.

This Heavy Metal (HM) was redesigned for easier mass production from the Gayrahm owned by the Yaman royal family of the planet Mizun.

Its main features are a panoramic display covering 360 degrees and the ability to transform into the Prowler Land Booster.

Bat-Shu
This is a Class A Heavy Metal (HM) whose Koam-built original is unaccounted for.
Its excellent overall balance has led to many replicas. Despite its heavily equipped appearance, its rubber body has relatively little armor.
The resulting low energy loss gives it excellent mobility and makes it well suited to close combat.

Ashura Temple
This is one of a series of Class A Heavy Metals (HMs) built on Gastogal and used by the Temple Knights.
Posaydal built a prototype replica. This HM emphasizes offense and has four arms and four Power Launchers, plus a Reverse Bomber and Energy Sash in its chest.

rows.notes: Encyclopedia narrator; no speaker/listener. Full source64–98 and neighbors63/99 read. Parent clarity edit independently rechecked against source before application.

rows.en:
Auge
This Class A Heavy Metal (HM) was built exclusively for Posaydal.
Its shoulder Round Binders conceal Power Launchers at their tips and can move independently of the arms. Their undersides also house a total of 30 lancers.
Nei borrowed it, but she did not bring out its true power.

{x00}

The AEUG repainted Gundam Mk-II Unit 3, captured from the Titans, to resemble the Gundam that fought in the One Year War.
There were three units, but the AEUG deployed only Unit 3 in combat. The others were used for spare parts.

{x00}

The source describes the captured-machine/AEUG context; entered combat can wrongly sound like an absolute claim across their Titans history.

rows.en:

This is an Earth Federation prototype Mobile Suit (MS).
The Titans developed it as a mainstay unit, but their prejudice against Spacenoids kept them from incorporating former Zeon technology, leaving it inferior to contemporary MS in some respects.
However, the high performance of the Gundam on which it was based compensates for its shortcomings.

{x00}

G-Defenser
This machine was developed to enhance Gundam Mk-II's armament and armor.
After it combines with the Mk-II, its cockpit is ejected and can be used as a small fighter.
G-Defenser itself can also operate independently.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia narrator; no speaker/listener. Full source64–98 and neighbors63/99 read. Context/decision: Cockpit itself ejects as a small fighter; G-Defenser independent operation retained as a separate claim.

Anaheim Electronics developed this transformable prototype Mobile Suit (MS) from Kamille's design, incorporating designs from Gundam Mk-II and Rick Dias.
A newly developed generator greatly increases its power output.
Its Waverider form enables atmospheric entry.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia narrator; no speaker/listener. Full source64–98 and neighbors63/99 read. Context/decision: Kamille design plus two design sources, new generator power gain and Waverider atmospheric entry retained.

The AEUG, a group of Spacenoids, developed this assault Mobile Suit (MS) to fight the Earth Federation.
Its structure incorporates the strengths of Rick Dom and Gundam, giving it extremely high maneuverability despite its ponderous silhouette.

{x00}
rows.notes: Encyclopedia narrator; no speaker/listener. Full source64–98 and neighbors63/99 read. Context/decision: AEUG source group description, anti-Federation role, both structural antecedents and silhouette/maneuverability contrast retained.

This Rick Dias was tuned exclusively for Quattro Bajeena.
Initially, only Quattro's unit was painted red, while the others were dark gray. All units were later standardized to red.

{x00}

For some reason, its body is green rather than the Titans colors.

rows.en:
Hizack
The Earth Federation designed and mass-produced this Mobile Suit (MS) after the One Year War.
It is largely an improved version of the former Principality of Zeon's Zaku, with a smaller, higher-output generator. However, its output is still too low to use a Beam Rifle and Beam Saber simultaneously.
Its body is painted blue.

{x00}

Marasai
Anaheim Electronics transferred this Mobile Suit (MS) to the Titans to curry favor with them as well.
Its excellent versatility made it a candidate to succeed Hizack, but its high cost kept it from becoming the mainstay unit.
However, it is said that the real reason was that it was made by Anaheim.

This Mobile Suit (MS) was the fourth machine Scirocco built aboard Jupitris.
Its joints have a fourfold or fivefold structure, it has verniers at 50 points throughout its body, and an extremely high-output generator is housed in its torso. It boasts power and speed far beyond what its appearance suggests.

Its versatility and reliability made it the most-produced AT on the Astragius continent. Equipment and parts are easy to replace, so many variants have emerged on different fronts.

Scopedog's weight has been reduced to the limit, leaving it with virtually no armor. Although intended for special missions, some pilots who prioritize mobility also preferred this machine.
